effectSummary.ko: 사냥 준비 직후 6초 안에 설치한 경계 쇠뇌 한 대는 지속시간이 2초, 최대 사격 수가 2회 늘어납니다. 기존 쇠뇌를 연장하지 않으며 한 번의 준비당 1대만 강화합니다.
effectSummary.en: The next Watch Ballista placed within 6s of Hunt Preparation gains 2s duration and 2 allowed shots. It cannot extend an existing ballista; one enhanced ballista per preparation.

description.ko: 6m 안에 쇠뇌 하나를 6초간 설치합니다. 1초마다 사거리 9m의 적 하나에게 D35% 물리 추가 피해를 주며 최대 6회 공격합니다. 시야 안의 표식 대상을 우선합니다. 사격은 기본 공격이나 A01로 세지 않습니다.
description.en: Place one ballista within 6m for 6s. Fire at one enemy within 9m each second for D35% secondary physical damage, up to 6 shots. Prefer a visible marked target. Shots are neither basic attacks nor A01.

description.ko: 자원 25를 회복하고 6초 안의 다음 유료 일반 액티브 한 번에 비용 감소 +20%p를 부여합니다. 무료 스킬·궁극기는 충전을 쓰지 않습니다.
description.en: Restore 25 resource and grant +20 percentage points of cost reduction to the next paid normal active within 6s. Free skills and ultimates do not consume the charge.

concept: A sturdy curved ranger utility belt with a compact ballista-like winding buckle, two short integrated bolt holders and a broad braced dark wooden center block. Bronze crank and dark leather straps, one wearable item; no freestanding turret.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LA45, Prepared Outpost, class Ranger, slot belt.
Subject design: A sturdy curved ranger utility belt with a compact ballista-like winding buckle, two short integrated bolt holders and a broad braced dark wooden center block. Bronze crank and dark leather straps, one wearable item; no freestanding turret.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: The next Watch Ballista placed within 6s of Hunt Preparation gains 2s duration and 2 allowed shots. It cannot extend an existing ballista; one enhanced ballista per preparation.
Direct skill context: A15 Watch Ballista — Place one ballista within 6m for 6s. Fire at one enemy within 9m each second for D35% secondary physical damage, up to 6 shots. Prefer a visible marked target. Shots are neither basic attacks nor A01.; A16 Hunt Preparation — Restore 25 resource and grant +20 percentage points of cost reduction to the next paid normal active within 6s. Free skills and ultimates do not consume the charge.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: 1024 by 1024 pixel square PNG requested, with genuinely native transparent alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Scale the equipment down within the square: the full object should occupy only the CENTRAL 72% of canvas width and height. Keep at least 14% completely empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides, including above crown peaks and around both weapon tips. Do not zoom in or maximize its size. Complete object, no clipping, no missing tips. This visible empty margin is essential. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
